data.title: 矢来美羽 · 港口晚班
data.description: 码头的灯刚亮起。美羽沿着栏杆检查停泊区，手里拿着折好的巡逻图。
data.action: standing beside a railing and checking a folded map
data.promptProse: Standing along the iron safety railing of a bustling coastal harbor at dusk, Miu holds an unfolded maritime patrol chart against the ocean breeze. Massive cargo freighters, illuminated harbor cranes, and the rhythmic lap of tidal waves reflecting sunset orange and purple hues frame her vigilant nighttime patrol.
